# Tinplate Labs

> Small, reliable tools for AI agents and developers. Apify Actors return structured JSON, charge per result (failed items are free), process data inside the caller's own run with no LLM and no telemetry, and can be called by agents through the Apify MCP server (https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=tinplatelabs/<actor-name>) or the Apify API (POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/tinplatelabs~<actor-name>/run-sync-get-dataset-items).

## Apify Actors

- [Document to Markdown](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/document-to-markdown/): Convert PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, CSV and scanned images to clean Markdown or JSON for LLMs and RAG. Tables and headings kept, OCR only where needed. $0.002 per page. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/document-to-markdown
- [Domain Intel](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/domain-intel/): One graded verdict per domain: RDAP registration and expiry, DNS and DNSSEC, SPF lookup count, DMARC, MTA-STS, DKIM and TLS certificate, with findings and fixes. $0.003 per domain. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/domain-intel
- [Contact Normalizer](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/contact-normalizer/): Validate and normalize phone numbers to E.164, e-mail addresses, names and countries in bulk, offline. Flags disposable and role e-mails, dedupes records. $0.0005 per record. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/contact-normalizer
- [Image Upscaler](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/image-upscaler/): Upscale images 2x, 3x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN, sharpening edges and removing JPEG artifacts without inventing content. Batch URLs, PNG/JPEG/WebP out. From $0.012 per image. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/image-upscaler
- [Site Discovery](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/site-discovery/): Per site: robots.txt rules and AI-crawler access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended), every sitemap expanded to a deduplicated URL list, and llms.txt. $0.002 per site. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/site-discovery
- [HTTP Request Tool for Agents](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/agent-http/): Batch HTTP requests for AI agents: parsed JSON, HTML as Markdown of the main content, redirect chain, timing, TLS details, retries and SSRF protection. $0.001 per request. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/agent-http
- [Dataset Toolkit](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/dataset-toolkit/): Merge Apify datasets and CSV, JSON, Excel or Parquet files, remove duplicates (exact or fuzzy), filter, sort and export to CSV, XLSX, JSON or Parquet. $0.002 per 1,000 rows. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/dataset-toolkit
- [Image OCR](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/image-ocr/): Extract text from screenshots, scans, receipts and photos in reading order, as text and Markdown, with every line and word's bounding box and confidence. PaddleOCR. $0.003 per image. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/image-ocr
- [Transcriber](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/transcriber/): Transcribe your audio and video files with Whisper: full text, timestamped segments, language detection, translation to English and SRT/WebVTT subtitles. From $0.007 per minute. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/transcriber
- [Video Frames](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/video-frames/): Extract frames from your videos every N seconds, N evenly spaced, at exact timestamps, keyframes or scene changes, plus a best-thumbnail pick and contact sheets. JPEG, PNG or WebP. $0.002 per frame. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/video-frames

## JetBrains plugin

- [Traefik Labels](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/traefik-labels/): JetBrains IDE plugin for Traefik Docker labels in Compose files: completion, unknown-label warnings with quick-fixes and hover docs, generated from Traefik's label reference. Free. Marketplace: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/34986-traefik-labels

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/privacy/): no cookies or tracking; per-tool data handling
- [EULA](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/legal/EULA): license for marketplace-distributed software
